key_facts.value_en: 2023-01-05 (brand and technology launch in Shenzhen; e4 platform and first two models U8 and U9 unveiled)
key_facts.value_zh: 2023-01-05（深圳品牌暨技术发布会；发布易四方平台及首批两款车型 U8、U9）
比亚迪股份有限公司（全资品牌）

key_facts.value_zh: 民营（民营车企比亚迪的全资品牌）

key_facts.value_zh: 超豪华新能源品牌，比亚迪品牌矩阵的最高端

key_facts.value_en: e4 (Yisanfang) four-motor drive, DiSus (Yunnian) body control and Blade Battery
key_facts.value_zh: 易四方四电机驱动、云辇车身控制、刀片电池

history.event_en: BYD officially announces its premium brand on the evening of 8 November 2022 and names it 'Yangwang'; the 'Yangwang' trademark had already been registered, and the price range was expected to be RMB 800,000-1.5 million (reported by Securities Times on 9 November 2022).
history.event_zh: 比亚迪于 2022 年 11 月 8 日晚正式公布旗下高端汽车品牌并定名「仰望」；「仰望」商标此前已完成注册，媒体预计价格区间在 80 万至 150 万元（证券时报 2022-11-09 报道）。

history.event_en: Shenzhen Yangwang Automobile Sales Co., Ltd. is established (Securities Times reported on 9 November 2022 that it had recently been set up); its direct shareholder is BYD Auto Industry Co., Ltd., the legal representative is He Zhiqi and the registered capital is RMB 1 million.
history.event_zh: 深圳仰望汽车销售有限公司成立（证券时报 2022-11-09 报道「近日已成立」）；直接股东为比亚迪汽车工业有限公司，法定代表人何志奇，注册资本 100 万元。

history.event_en: BYD holds the 'Dare to Cross the Galaxy' brand and technology launch in Shenzhen, unveiling the Yangwang brand, the e4 (Yisanfang) four-motor platform and its first two models, the U8 hardcore off-road SUV and U9 supercar; chairman and president Wang Chuanfu drives the U8 onto the stage.
history.event_zh: 比亚迪在深圳举行「敢越星河」仰望品牌暨技术发布会，发布仰望品牌、易四方四电机平台及首批两款车型——硬派越野 U8 与纯电超跑 U9；董事长兼总裁王传福亲自驾驶 U8 入场。

history.event_en: The Yangwang U8 Luxury Edition is launched at RMB 1.098 million.
history.event_zh: 仰望 U8 豪华版正式上市，售价 109.8 万元。

history.event_en: First deliveries of the U8 Luxury Edition begin in late October 2023, making November 2023 the first full delivery month.
history.event_zh: 仰望 U8 豪华版首批于 2023 年 10 月下旬开始交付，11 月成为首个完整交付月。

history.event_en: The U8 records cumulative sales of 2,001 units over November-December 2023 (1,593 in December).
The Yangwang U9 pure-electric supercar is launched at RMB 1.68 million, with deliveries starting from mid-2024.
history.event_zh: 仰望 U9 纯电超跑正式上市，售价 168 万元，2024 年中开始交付。

history.event_en: The U8 reaches 5,000 deliveries within 132 days of first delivery, which the company describes as the fastest ramp-up for a Chinese million-yuan SUV.
history.event_zh: 仰望 U8 达成 5,000 台交付，用时 132 天，官方称开创中国百万级 SUV 车型销量最快达成纪录。

history.event_en: At the Beijing Auto Show, the U8 Off-road Master Edition is launched from RMB 1.098 million, the DiSus-Z (Yunnian-Z) suspension is released and debuts on the U7, and the U8, U9 and U7 appear together for the first time.
history.event_zh: 北京车展上，仰望 U8 越野玩家版上市（109.8 万元起），云辇-Z 技术发布并首发搭载于仰望 U7；仰望 U8、U9、U7 三款车型首次集体亮相。

history.event_en: The Yangwang Business Academy, a study organisation for Yangwang owners, is established, with BYD chairman and president Wang Chuanfu as its president.
history.event_zh: 面向仰望用户的商业研学组织「仰望商业研究院」成立，比亚迪董事长兼总裁王传福担任院长。

history.event_en: The Yangwang U7 flagship sedan is launched in pure-electric and plug-in hybrid versions, from RMB 628,000 (five-seat) and RMB 708,000 (four-seat).
history.event_zh: 仰望 U7 旗舰轿车（纯电及插混）正式上市，五座版 62.8 万元起、四座版 70.8 万元起。

history.event_en: Yangwang announces cumulative sales have passed 10,000 units, the first domestic million-yuan car brand to reach the milestone; New Oriental founder Yu Minhong becomes the 10,000th owner.
history.event_zh: 仰望官宣累计销量突破 1 万辆，成为首个达成该里程碑的国产百万级汽车品牌；新东方创始人俞敏洪成为第 1 万辆车主。

history.event_en: The Yangwang U8L Dingshi Edition, a full-size administrative luxury SUV, is launched from RMB 1.28 million.
history.event_zh: 全尺寸行政豪华 SUV 仰望 U8L 鼎世版正式上市，售价 128 万元起。

history.event_en: The U9 Xtreme posts a world-record top speed of 496.22 km/h at the ATP Papenburg test track in Germany (announced 20 September 2025), topping the global car speed ranking.
history.event_zh: 仰望 U9 Xtreme 在德国 ATP 测试场以 496.22 km/h 创下全球汽车极速纪录（9 月 20 日对外发布），登顶全球汽车极速榜。

history.event_en: The Nurburgring official lap-time list certifies the U9 Xtreme at 6:59.157, making it the fastest production electric supercar on the Nordschleife and the first to break the seven-minute barrier (the lap was set on 22 August 2025).
history.event_zh: 纽博格林官方圈速榜认证仰望 U9 Xtreme 圈速 6:59.157，登顶纽北量产纯电超跑圈速榜，成为首款跑进 7 分钟的量产纯电超跑（成绩于 2025 年 8 月 22 日做出）。

history.event_en: BYD Executive Vice President Stella Li announces that Yangwang will begin its global rollout in the Middle East (UAE) in early 2026, followed by Europe and the Americas.
history.event_zh: 比亚迪执行副总裁李柯在郑州发布会上宣布，仰望将于 2026 年初从中东（阿联酋）开始全球布局，随后进入欧洲与美洲。

history.event_en: The 2026 Yangwang U7, U8 and U8L are launched with BYD's second-generation Blade Battery and flash charging, priced from RMB 658,000, 1.008 million and 1.30 million respectively.
history.event_zh: 2026 款仰望 U7、U8、U8L 上市，全系升级第二代刀片电池与闪充，起售价分别为 65.8 万、100.8 万、130 万元。

history.event_en: At the Beijing Auto Show, the first production-standard U9 Xtreme makes its debut; BYD brand and PR general manager Li Yunfei later discloses that it sells for over RMB 20 million per unit, limited to 30 units worldwide.
history.event_zh: 北京车展上，首台按量产标准打造的仰望 U9 Xtreme 首发；比亚迪集团品牌及公关处总经理李云飞其后披露，U9 Xtreme 单台售价超 2,000 万元、全球限量 30 台。

history.event_en: The U8L Dingcang four-seat edition is launched at RMB 1.458 million, alongside the opening of the Yangwang global haute-couture centre in Shanghai.
history.event_zh: 仰望 U8L 鼎藏版四座正式上市，售价 145.8 万元；同日仰望全球高定中心在上海开业。

history.event_en: Yangwang names its first ultra-luxury executive sedan (formerly codenamed HU) 'Dingyao' (YANGWANG ALTIOR) and says it will make its world debut in Dubai in early November 2026.
history.event_zh: 仰望首款超豪华行政轿车（原代号 HU）定名「鼎曜」（YANGWANG ALTIOR），官方宣布将于 2026 年 11 月初在迪拜全球首发。

brands.role_en: Million-yuan new-energy hardcore off-road SUV; the brand's first model and its volume mainstay.
brands.role_zh: 百万级新能源硬派越野 SUV，品牌首款车型，也是销量主力。
brands.price_band: 豪华版 2023-09-20 上市 109.8 万元；越野玩家版 2024-04-25 上市 109.8 万元起；2026 款 100.8 万元起（2026-03-05）。Luxury Edition from RMB 1.098m (2023-09-20); Off-road Master Edition from RMB 1.098m (2024-04-25); 2026 model from RMB 1.008m (2026-03-05)
brands.owner_note_en: Launched 2023-09-20 as the first model on the e4 platform with DiSus-P, with 1,200 hp, 880 kW max power, 8,700 Nm wheel-end torque, a 3.6-second 0-100 km/h, about 1,000 km CLTC combined range and 30-minute emergency floating. It recorded cumulative sales of 2,001 units over November-December 2023 (1,593 in December) and about 7,254 in full-year 2024, ranking fourth among million-yuan SUVs. In 2025 the U8 series (including the U8L) delivered 2,728 units, a model split compiled by blogger Xiaodi Kuaibao. The Off-road Master Edition, launched 2024-04-25, offers an optional RMB 100,000 in-vehicle drone system; the 2026 model adds the second-generation Blade Battery, flash charging, a combined range of 1,205 km and eTCS2.0.
brands.owner_note_zh: 2023-09-20 上市，为首款搭载易四方与云辇-P 的车型，拥有 1200 匹马力、880kW 最大功率、8700N·m 轮端扭矩、零百 3.6 秒、CLTC 综合续航约 1000 公里与 30 分钟应急浮水能力。2023 年 11–12 月累计销量 2,001 辆（12 月 1,593 辆），2024 年全年约 7,254 辆，位列百万级 SUV 年度销量第四；2025 年 U8 系列（含 U8L）交付 2,728 辆（分车型为博主「小迪快报」整理口径）。越野玩家版于 2024-04-25 上市，可选装 10 万元的车载无人机系统；2026 款升级第二代刀片电池、闪充，综合续航 1205 公里，并搭载 eTCS2.0。

brands.role_en: Full-size administrative luxury SUV, the long-wheelbase flagship of the U8 family.
brands.role_zh: 全尺寸行政豪华 SUV，U8 车系的长轴距旗舰。
brands.price_band: 鼎世版 2025-09-12 上市 128 万元起；2026 款鼎世版 130 万元起（2026-03-05）；鼎藏版四座 2026-08-05 上市 145.8 万元。Dingshi Edition from RMB 1.28m (2025-09-12); 2026 Dingshi from RMB 1.30m (2026-03-05); Dingcang four-seat edition RMB 1.458m (2026-08-05)
brands.owner_note_en: Launched 2025-09-12 as the brand's fourth model, featuring an industry-first all-aluminium frame, DiSus-P+, a 2+2+2 six-seat layout switchable to executive four-seat, dimensions of 5,400 x 2,049 x 1,921 mm and a 3,250 mm wheelbase. On 2026-08-05 the U8L Dingcang four-seat edition was launched at RMB 1.458 million, a 2+2 layout with the second-generation Blade Battery, flash charging, Tiantong-1 satellite communication and a CLTC combined range of 1,205 km (230 km pure-electric), with matrix 'ding' headlights and an oracle-bone-script gold badge.
brands.owner_note_zh: 2025-09-12 上市，为品牌第四款车型，搭载行业首个全铝大车架、云辇-P+、2+2+2 六座布局（可切换行政四座），车身尺寸 5400×2049×1921mm、轴距 3250mm。2026-08-05 鼎藏版四座上市，售价 145.8 万元，采用 2+2 大四座布局，搭载第二代刀片电池、闪充、天通一号卫星通信，CLTC 综合续航 1205 公里（纯电 230 公里），外观采用矩阵式鼎型大灯与甲骨文黄金车标。

brands.role_en: Flagship sedan, the first model with the DiSus-Z fully-electric suspension.
brands.role_zh: 旗舰轿车，全球首搭云辇-Z 全电悬架。
brands.price_band: 2025-03-27 上市：五座 62.8 万元起、四座 70.8 万元起；2026 款 65.8 万元起（2026-03-05）。Launched 2025-03-27 from RMB 628,000 (five-seat) / RMB 708,000 (four-seat); 2026 model from RMB 658,000
brands.owner_note_en: Launched 2025-03-27 in pure-electric and plug-in hybrid versions, the world's first mass-produced electric suspension (DiSus-Z), with over 1,300 hp and a 2.9-second 0-100 km/h. The 2026 model adds the second-generation Blade Battery: the EV version's battery grows to 150.01 kWh with 1,006 km CLTC range, and the PHEV reaches 1,100 km combined, with flash charging. The U7 delivered 1,953 units in 2025 (blogger-compiled model split).
brands.owner_note_zh: 2025-03-27 上市，提供纯电与插混，全球首款量产电悬架（云辇-Z），马力超 1300 匹、零百 2.9 秒。2026 款升级第二代刀片电池并支持闪充，纯电版电池容量增至 150.01kWh、CLTC 续航 1006 公里，插混版综合续航 1100 公里。2025 年交付 1,953 辆（分车型为博主整理口径）。

brands.role_en: Million-yuan pure-electric performance supercar, the brand's performance flagship.
brands.role_zh: 百万级纯电性能超跑，品牌性能旗舰。
brands.price_band: 2024-02-25 上市 168 万元。Launched 2024-02-25 at RMB 1.68 million
brands.owner_note_en: Launched 2024-02-25 with the e4 platform and DiSus-X intelligent body-control system; 0-100 km/h in 2.36 s and a 309.19 km/h top speed. Deliveries started mid-2024; the U9 delivered 104 units in 2025 (blogger-compiled model split).
brands.owner_note_zh: 2024-02-25 上市，搭载易四方与云辇-X 智能车身控制系统，零百 2.36 秒、极速 309.19 km/h。2024 年中开始交付；2025 年交付 104 辆（分车型为博主整理口径）。

brands.role_en: Bespoke, individually customised electric hypercar, the brand's performance pinnacle, limited to 30 units worldwide.
brands.role_zh: 深度定制电动超跑，品牌性能巅峰之作，全球限量 30 台。
brands.price_band: 单台售价超 2,000 万元、全球限量 30 台（量产版 2026-04-24 首发，售价 2026-04-30 披露）。Over RMB 20 million per unit, limited to 30 units worldwide (production version debuted 2026-04-24; price disclosed 2026-04-30)
brands.owner_note_en: The U9 Xtreme recorded a 496.22 km/h top speed (September 2025, ATP Papenburg) and a 6:59.157 Nurburgring Nordschleife lap certified on 2025-10-21, becoming the fastest production electric supercar on the Nordschleife and the first to break the seven-minute barrier. It is built on the world's first mass-produced all-domain 1200V ultra-high-voltage platform with four motors producing over 3,000 PS and a 1,217 PS/tonne power-to-weight ratio; the record lap was driven by German racer Moritz Kranz. The first production-standard unit debuted at the 2026 Beijing Auto Show; BYD brand and PR general manager Li Yunfei said it sells for over RMB 20 million per unit, limited to 30 units.
brands.owner_note_zh: U9 Xtreme 于 2025 年 9 月在德国 ATP 测试场以 496.22 km/h 创下全球汽车极速纪录，其纽博格林北环圈速 6:59.157 于 2025-10-21 获官方认证，登顶纽北量产纯电超跑圈速榜，成为首款跑进 7 分钟的量产纯电超跑。该车基于全球首个量产全域 1200V 超高压平台，四电机综合输出超 3000 匹、推重比 1217 匹/吨，创纪录圈速由德国车手 Moritz Kranz 驾驶完成。首台量产标准车型于 2026-04-24 北京车展首发；比亚迪集团品牌及公关处总经理李云飞披露，该车单台售价超 2,000 万元、全球限量 30 台。

brands.role_en: Upcoming ultra-luxury executive flagship sedan (codenamed HU), positioned against the Rolls-Royce Ghost and Mercedes-Maybach S-Class.
brands.role_zh: 即将推出的超豪华行政旗舰轿车（代号 HU），对标劳斯莱斯古思特、迈巴赫 S 级。
brands.price_band: 官方未公布售价；CarNewsChina 报道约 200 万元。Not yet officially announced; CarNewsChina reports around RMB 2 million
brands.owner_note_en: Announced in October 2026 and named Dingyao (YANGWANG ALTIOR) on 2026-10-27; 'Altior' derives from the Latin for 'higher'. The teaser shows a 'ding'-style front end, rear-hinged doors and a roof-mounted lidar. Media report a body length of 5,500 mm and a 3,350 mm wheelbase; Yangwang says the car will make its world debut in Dubai in early November 2026, with no official details yet disclosed.
brands.owner_note_zh: 2026 年 10 月官宣，2026-10-27 定名「鼎曜」（YANGWANG ALTIOR），ALTIOR 源自拉丁语、意为「更高」。预告图显示「鼎」式前脸、对开式车门与车顶激光雷达；媒体报道车长 5,500mm、轴距 3,350mm。官方称将于 2026 年 11 月初在迪拜全球首发，具体细节尚未公布。

financials.standard: Not applicable — Yangwang is not separately listed and discloses no brand-level financial statements
financials.note_en: Yangwang is a wholly owned brand of BYD Company Limited and does not publish separate financial statements. Revenue, gross margin, net profit, R&D and cash flow are therefore not disclosed at the brand level, and this table intentionally has no rows. BYD's consolidated figures are reported under PRC GAAP, with net profit stated as profit attributable to owners of the parent company (归母净利润); in FY2025 BYD reported revenue of about RMB 803.96 billion and profit attributable to shareholders of the listed company of RMB 32.619 billion. Those figures are covered in the BYD (byd) deep research. This page does not constitute any trading recommendation.
financials.note_zh: 仰望为比亚迪股份有限公司旗下全资品牌，未单独披露品牌层面的营收、毛利率、净利润、研发投入与现金流等财务数据，故本表不列财务数字。比亚迪集团合并口径财务数据按中国企业会计准则编制，净利润为「归属于母公司股东的净利润」（归母净利润）口径；2025 财年比亚迪实现营业收入约 8039.6 亿元、归属于上市公司股东的净利润 326.19 亿元。比亚迪集团财务数据详见比亚迪（byd）深度研究。本页不构成任何交易推荐。

overview.en:
Yangwang is the ultra-luxury new-energy vehicle brand of BYD Company Limited, positioned at the top of BYD's brand portfolio and aimed at the million-yuan (RMB 1 million-plus) and above segment. On 5 January 2023, BYD held the 'Dare to Cross the Galaxy' brand and technology launch in Shenzhen, officially unveiling the Yangwang brand, the e4 (Yisanfang) four-motor platform, and its first two models — the U8 hardcore off-road SUV and the U9 electric supercar — with chairman and president Wang Chuanfu driving the U8 onto the stage.[s4][s6] Its slogan is 'surpassing the extreme, never seen before', and its products are built on the 'Yangwang architecture', which integrates six core technology modules — powertrain, chassis, battery, super body, intelligent driving and intelligent cockpit, with e4, DiSus and Blade Battery as its signature technologies.[s1][s3]

As of the research cut-off date (2026-10-29), the line-up spans the U7 flagship sedan, U8 hardcore off-road SUV, U8L administrative luxury SUV, U9 supercar and the limited-run U9 Xtreme hypercar, with the 2026 model year upgraded to BYD's second-generation Blade Battery and flash charging; a first ultra-luxury executive sedan, named Dingyao (YANGWANG ALTIOR) on 27 October 2026, is scheduled for a world debut in Dubai in early November 2026.[s1][s14][s24] Within BYD's brand hierarchy, Yangwang sits above the Dynasty and Ocean series (mainstream), Denza (luxury) and Fangchengbao (personalised off-road), making it the group's highest-priced brand.[s6]

In sales terms, Yangwang recorded cumulative sales of 2,001 units over November-December 2023, about 7,400 units in 2024 (U8 about 7,254), and 4,785 units in 2025 (U8 series 2,728, U7 1,953, U9 104, model split compiled by blogger Xiaodi Kuaibao); on 21 April 2025 it became the first Chinese million-yuan brand to pass 10,000 cumulative sales.[s7][s12][s15][s17][s23] Yangwang is not separately listed and discloses no brand-level financial statements; BYD's consolidated figures are covered in the BYD deep research.[s21][s22]
overview.zh:
仰望（Yangwang）是比亚迪股份有限公司旗下的超豪华新能源汽车品牌，位于比亚迪品牌矩阵最顶端，主攻百万元级及以上市场。2023 年 1 月 5 日，比亚迪在深圳举行「敢越星河」仰望品牌暨技术发布会，正式发布仰望品牌与易四方四电机平台，并同步亮相首批两款车型——百万级新能源硬派越野 U8 与百万级纯电性能超跑 U9，董事长兼总裁王传福亲自驾驶 U8 入场。[s4][s6] 品牌口号为「超越极致，前所未有」，产品以「仰望架构」六大核心技术模块为底座，涵盖动力系统、底盘系统、电池技术、超级车身技术、智能驾驶与智能座舱，其代表技术为易四方、云辇与刀片电池。[s1][s3]

截至研究截止日（2026-10-29），仰望已形成 U7（旗舰轿车）、U8（硬派越野 SUV）、U8L（行政豪华 SUV）、U9（纯电超跑）与限量高定超跑 U9 Xtreme 的产品矩阵，2026 款全系升级第二代刀片电池与闪充；首款超豪华行政轿车于 2026-10-27 定名「鼎曜」（YANGWANG ALTIOR），预计 2026 年 11 月初在迪拜全球首发。[s1][s14][s24] 在比亚迪品牌体系中，仰望位于王朝网与海洋网（主流）、腾势（豪华）、方程豹（个性越野）之上，是集团价格带最高的品牌。[s6]

销量方面，仰望 2023 年 11–12 月累计销量 2,001 辆，2024 年约 7,400 辆（其中 U8 约 7,254 辆），2025 年 4,785 辆（U8 系列 2,728 辆、U7 1,953 辆、U9 104 辆，分车型为博主「小迪快报」整理）；2025 年 4 月 21 日成为首个累计销量破万的国产百万级汽车品牌。[s7][s12][s15][s17][s23] 仰望未单独上市、不披露独立财务数据，母公司比亚迪财务数据见比亚迪深度研究。[s21][s22]

current.en:
Model line-up and positioning

As of 2026-10-29, Yangwang's line-up comprises: the U8 hardcore off-road SUV (Luxury Edition launched 2023-09-20 at RMB 1.098 million; Off-road Master Edition 2024-04-25; 2026 model from RMB 1.008 million); the full-size administrative luxury U8L (Dingshi Edition launched 2025-09-12 from RMB 1.28 million; 2026 Dingshi from RMB 1.30 million; Dingcang four-seat edition launched 2026-08-05 at RMB 1.458 million); the U7 flagship sedan (launched 2025-03-27 from RMB 628,000, 2026 model from RMB 658,000); the U9 electric supercar (launched 2024-02-25 at RMB 1.68 million); and the 30-unit bespoke U9 Xtreme (over RMB 20 million).[s5][s7][s11][s12][s14][s30][s19]

Core technologies

The Yangwang architecture integrates six core technology modules: powertrain, chassis, battery, super body, intelligent driving and intelligent cockpit.[s3] The e4 platform uses four independently driven motors to control each wheel's torque, enabling tank turns, stable driving after a tyre blowout and emergency floating; the DiSus body-control system appears as DiSus-P on the U8/U8L, DiSus-X on the U9 and DiSus-Z — described as the world's first mass-produced electric suspension — on the U7.[s5][s9][s11] The U7 also features 20-degree bi-directional rear-wheel steering and e4 agile steering with a 4.85 m turning radius, enabling parallel-shift parking.[s28] The e4 concept traces back to BYD's ET electric concept car of about two decades earlier, later industrialised as the e4 platform.[s6] From 2026 the range upgrades to the second-generation Blade Battery and flash charging, which BYD describes as '5 minutes charged, 9 minutes full'.[s14] BYD also offered a flash-charging benefit: non-commercial owners who paid a deposit before 11 May 2026 get one year of free charging at BYD flash-charging stations after delivery.[s14] The 2026 U8 lifts combined range 20.5% to 1,205 km with a 9C charge rate and adds a 3nm 5G cockpit chip and the God's Eye 5.0 system; the 2026 U8L adds full-scenario privacy safety, NOA blowout-stable stopping and automatic emergency-floating activation; the 2026 U7 debuts the DiSus-A+ intelligent air suspension.[s14] The U8 Luxury Edition is a plug-in hybrid with 1,200 hp, 880 kW peak power, 8,700 Nm wheel-end torque, a 3.6-second 0-100 km/h, about 1,000 km CLTC combined range, 150 mm suspension travel and 30-minute emergency floating; the U9 has four motors and over 1,300 hp, with 2.36-second 0-100 km/h and a 309.19 km/h top speed.[s5][s8]

Manufacturing and capacity

Yangwang does not separately disclose its plants or capacity; its models are produced within BYD's manufacturing system, and no brand-level employee count is published.[s21] BYD does not break out Yangwang in its segment reporting, so the brand's standalone economics cannot be assessed from public filings.[s22]

Domestic market position

Yangwang was the first Chinese brand to sell new-energy vehicles into the million-yuan segment at meaningful scale: the U8 delivered about 7,254 units in 2024, ranking fourth among million-yuan SUVs, and cumulative sales passed 10,000 in April 2025.[s17][s23] The U8 sold 1,593 units in December 2023 and 1,652 in January 2024, staying above 1,500 for two consecutive months.[s7] Volume then cooled: full-year 2025 sales were 4,785 units, while China EV DataTracker figures relayed by CarNewsChina put January-September 2026 at 3,251 units, up 38.9% year on year.[s15][s24]

Owner community and customer operations

Yangwang cultivates a high-net-worth owner community: the Yangwang Business Academy, set up in November 2024, provides a business-exchange platform for entrepreneur owners under the stated philosophy of 'sell one car, make one friend'; per Securities Times, over 80% of U8 owners are entrepreneurs, partners or executives.[s2][s28]

Overseas business

Yangwang's global rollout is at an early stage. The U8 Arabian Edition is sold in the UAE at AED 659,900 through the exclusive distributor Al-Futtaim Electric Mobility, with 1,180 hp, up to 800 km of range (WLTC) and about 112 km of pure-electric range (WLTC), plus a 6-year/150,000 km vehicle warranty and an 8-year unlimited-km battery warranty; it carries 38 smart sensors with ADAS and a 22-speaker Dynaudio system, retains 30-minute emergency floating (about 3 km/h) and on-the-spot turning, and its DiSus-P offers up to 150 mm of lift.[s26] BYD Executive Vice President Stella Li announced in November 2025 that the brand would begin its global rollout in the Middle East (UAE) in early 2026, followed by Europe and the Americas.[s18][s27]
current.zh:
产品谱系与定位

截至 2026-10-29，仰望车型包括：硬派越野 U8（豪华版 2023-09-20 上市 109.8 万元，越野玩家版 2024-04-25 上市，2026 款 100.8 万元起）；全尺寸行政豪华 SUV U8L（鼎世版 2025-09-12 上市 128 万元起，2026 款鼎世版 130 万元起，鼎藏版四座 2026-08-05 上市 145.8 万元）；旗舰轿车 U7（2025-03-27 上市，五座 62.8 万/四座 70.8 万起，2026 款 65.8 万起）；纯电超跑 U9（2024-02-25 上市 168 万元）；以及全球限量 30 台的高定超跑 U9 Xtreme（单台超 2000 万元）。[s5][s7][s11][s12][s14][s30][s19]

核心技术

仰望架构整合六大核心技术模块：动力系统、底盘系统、电池技术、超级车身技术、智能驾驶、智能座舱。[s3] 易四方是四电机独立驱动平台，可毫秒级独立控制四轮扭矩，实现原地掉头、爆胎稳行、应急浮水等功能；云辇智能车身控制系统分云辇-P（U8/U8L）、云辇-X（U9）、云辇-Z（U7，全球首款量产电悬架）。[s5][s9][s11] 其中 U7 配备双向 20 度后轮转向与易四方敏捷转向，转弯半径 4.85 米，可实现平行横移泊车。[s28] 易四方技术的雏形可追溯至比亚迪约 20 年前发布的 ET 纯电动概念车，后以易四方平台形式量产上车。[s6] 2026 年起全系升级第二代刀片电池与闪充，官方称「5 分钟充好、9 分钟充饱」。[s14] 官方另推出闪充畅行礼遇：2026 年 5 月 11 日前支付 2026 款定金的非营运车主，交付后一年内在比亚迪闪充桩免费充电。[s14] 2026 款 U8 综合续航提升 20.5% 至 1205 公里、充电倍率达 9C，并搭载 3nm 5G 车机芯片与天神之眼 5.0；2026 款 U8L 新增全场景隐私安全、NOA 爆胎稳行稳停与应急浮水自动开启；2026 款 U7 首次搭载云辇-A+ 智能空气车身控制系统。[s14] 具体到车型，U8 豪华版为插电混动，拥有 1200 匹马力、880kW 最大功率、8700N·m 轮端扭矩，零百 3.6 秒，CLTC 综合续航约 1000 公里，150mm 悬架调节行程并具备 30 分钟应急浮水能力；U9 搭载四个电机、整车超 1300 匹马力，零百 2.36 秒、极速 309.19 km/h。[s5][s8]

工厂与产能

仰望未单独披露工厂、产能与员工数，其车型在比亚迪体系内工厂生产；比亚迪年报亦未单列仰望的财务分部。[s21] 因此无法从公开文件评估品牌独立经营状况。[s22]

国内市场地位

仰望是首个把国产新能源车以一定规模卖进百万级市场的品牌：U8 2024 年交付约 7,254 辆、位列百万级 SUV 销量第四，2025 年 4 月累计破万。[s17][s23] U8 在 2023 年 12 月与 2024 年 1 月分别销售 1,593 辆、1,652 辆，连续两个月突破 1,500 辆。[s7] 随后销量回落：2025 年全年 4,785 辆；据 China EV DataTracker 数据（CarNewsChina 转引），2026 年 1–9 月交付 3,251 辆，同比增长 38.9%。[s15][s24]

用户与社群经营

仰望注重经营高净值用户社群：2024 年 11 月成立的「仰望商业研究院」为企业家车主提供商业交流平台，官方提出「卖一台车，交一个朋友」的经营理念；据证券时报报道，U8 超过 80% 的车主为企业家、合伙人或高管。[s2][s28]

海外业务

仰望的全球化刚起步。U8 Arabian Edition 在阿联酋由独家经销商 Al-Futtaim Electric Mobility 销售，官网标价 659,900 迪拉姆，拥有 1,180 匹马力、最高 800 公里续航（WLTC）、纯电约 112 公里（WLTC），并提供 6 年/15 万公里整车质保与 8 年不限里程电池质保；该车配备 38 个传感器与 ADAS 及 22 扬声器 Dynaudio 音响，保留 30 分钟应急浮水（约 3km/h）与原地掉头能力，云辇-P 可提供最高 150mm 升降。[s26] 比亚迪执行副总裁李柯于 2025 年 11 月宣布，仰望将于 2026 年初从中东（阿联酋）开始全球布局，随后进入欧洲与美洲。[s18][s27]

leadership.en:
Brand ownership and governance

Yangwang is a brand of BYD Company Limited. Its operating entity, Shenzhen Yangwang Automobile Sales Co., Ltd., was established in November 2022 (Securities Times reported on 9 November 2022 that it had recently been set up); its direct shareholder is BYD Auto Industry Co., Ltd., the legal representative is He Zhiqi and the registered capital is RMB 1 million.[s29] Yangwang is not separately listed; the actual controller of the parent BYD is Wang Chuanfu, who is also BYD's chairman and president.[s21]

Brand founder

The Yangwang brand was created under BYD chairman and president Wang Chuanfu, who drove the U8 onto the stage at the January 2023 launch and serves as president of the Yangwang Business Academy, established in November 2024.[s4][s2][s28]

Current management

The general manager of the Yangwang sales division is Hu Xiaoqing. CarNewsChina refers to her as 'Yangwang sales division general manager' in its October 2026 coverage of the Altior naming, and International Finance News described her as 'Yangwang automobile general manager' at the U8L launch in September 2025.[s24][s12] At group level, BYD Executive Vice President Stella Li announced Yangwang's global rollout plan in November 2025, and BYD brand and PR general manager Li Yunfei disclosed the U9 Xtreme price in April 2026.[s18][s19]
leadership.zh:
品牌归属与治理

仰望为比亚迪股份有限公司旗下品牌。运营主体深圳仰望汽车销售有限公司于 2022 年 11 月成立（证券时报 2022-11-09 报道「近日已成立」），直接股东为比亚迪汽车工业有限公司，法定代表人何志奇，注册资本 100 万元。[s29] 仰望未单独上市；母公司比亚迪实际控制人为王传福，其同时担任比亚迪董事长兼总裁。[s21]

品牌创立者

仰望品牌由比亚迪股份有限公司董事长兼总裁王传福主导创立。在 2023 年 1 月的发布会上，王传福亲自驾驶仰望 U8 入场，并在 2024 年 11 月成立的仰望商业研究院担任院长。[s4][s2][s28]

现任管理层

现任仰望销售事业部总经理为胡晓庆。CarNewsChina 在 2026 年 10 月报道鼎曜命名时称其为「仰望销售事业部总经理」，国际金融报在 2025 年 9 月 U8L 上市时称其为「仰望汽车总经理」。[s24][s12] 集团层面，比亚迪执行副总裁李柯于 2025 年 11 月宣布仰望全球布局计划，比亚迪集团品牌及公关处总经理李云飞于 2026 年 4 月披露 U9 Xtreme 售价。[s18][s19]

competition.en:
Our judgment: the competitive field. Yangwang's million-yuan-plus models compete with incumbent luxury and ultra-luxury nameplates — the Land Rover Range Rover and Defender, Mercedes-Benz GLS and G-Class, Maybach S-Class, Rolls-Royce Ghost and Porsche supercars — and, domestically, with other Chinese ultra-luxury efforts such as Hongqi's Golden Sunflower and Huawei/JAC's Maextro S800. This is an analytical selection of the competitive set, not a sales ranking.[s17][s24]

Our judgment: strengths. Yangwang is the first Chinese brand to sell new-energy vehicles into the million-yuan segment at meaningful scale: the U8 ranked fourth among million-yuan SUVs in 2024, and cumulative sales passed 10,000 in April 2025.[s17][s23] It is differentiated by BYD's vertically integrated e4, DiSus and Blade Battery stack, and the U9 Xtreme's 496.22 km/h top speed and 6:59.157 Nurburgring lap place it in the global top-tier supercar discussion.[s31] Yangwang also cultivates a high-net-worth owner community — over 80% of U8 owners are entrepreneurs, partners or executives, per Securities Times — through its Business Academy and the limited-run U9 Xtreme, reinforcing scarcity.[s2][s28]

Our judgment: price and segment competition. In million-yuan SUVs, the U8/U8L face the Range Rover and Defender, Mercedes-Benz GLS and BMW X7, while domestic rivals such as Dongfeng's M-Hero 917 also target the luxury off-road market.[s17] In the ultra-luxury executive sedan segment, the upcoming Dingyao is positioned against the Mercedes-Maybach S-Class and Rolls-Royce Ghost; media report a 'ding'-style front end, rear-hinged doors and a body length of 5,500 mm.[s24][s25]

Our judgment: weaknesses and uncertainties. Volume is small and volatile — 4,785 units in 2025 — and the U8 has cooled; the brand has yet to build a second U8-scale hit. Brand equity, channels and after-sales need time to accumulate, and the overseas rollout is just beginning. In the ultra-luxury segment, where buyers weight brand history and social recognition, Yangwang will struggle to displace incumbents on parameters and features alone in the near term.[s15][s17][s18]
competition.zh:
我们的判断：竞争范围。仰望的百万级以上车型主要面对路虎揽胜/卫士、奔驰 GLS/G 级、迈巴赫 S 级、劳斯莱斯古思特、保时捷等传统豪华与超豪华品牌，以及国内的红旗金葵花、尊界 S800 等。此为分析选定的竞争范围，不是销量排名。[s17][s24]

我们的判断：优势。仰望是首个把国产新能源车以一定规模卖进百万级市场的品牌：U8 2024 年位列百万级 SUV 销量第四，2025 年 4 月累计破万。[s17][s23] 其依托比亚迪垂直整合的易四方、云辇、刀片电池建立技术差异化，U9 Xtreme 更以 496.22 km/h 极速与 6:59.157 纽北圈速进入全球顶级超跑讨论。[s31] 仰望还通过仰望商业研究院与 U9 Xtreme 限量发售经营高净值用户圈层——据证券时报报道，U8 超过 80% 的车主为企业家、合伙人或高管——强化品牌稀缺性。[s2][s28]

我们的判断：价格与细分竞争。在百万级 SUV 领域，U8/U8L 主要面对路虎揽胜/卫士、奔驰 GLS、宝马 X7 等在位车型，国产方面东风猛士 917 等也进入豪华越野市场。[s17] 在超豪华行政轿车领域，仰望即将推出的鼎曜对标迈巴赫 S 级、劳斯莱斯古思特，媒体报道其采用「鼎」式前脸、对开式车门，车长 5,500mm。[s24][s25]

我们的判断：短板与不确定性。销量规模小且波动——2025 年全年 4,785 辆，U8 热度降温，品牌尚未打造出第二款 U8 级产品；品牌溢价、渠道与售后仍需时间积累，海外布局刚起步。在超豪华市场，用户对品牌历史与社交认同的看重，也意味着仰望难以仅靠参数与配置在短期内替代传统豪华品牌。[s15][s17][s18]

outlook.en:
Company plans. BYD has said Yangwang will begin its global rollout in the Middle East (UAE) in early 2026, then Europe and the Americas.[s18][s27] On product cadence, the 2026 U7/U8/U8L launched in March 2026, the U8L Dingcang four-seat edition followed in August 2026, and the first ultra-luxury executive sedan, Dingyao (YANGWANG ALTIOR), will make its world debut in Dubai in early November 2026.[s14][s30][s24][s25] These are disclosed plans and targets, not completed results.

Our judgment. Yangwang is best understood as a technology flagship that sets BYD's high-end credentials rather than a volume business; its near-term significance lies in whether the 2026 refreshed range can stabilise domestic sales and whether the UAE/Middle East launch, the U9 Xtreme and the Dingyao can establish the brand with ultra-luxury buyers. The UAE U8 is priced at AED 659,900 on the official site — above the base Range Rover's roughly AED 510,000 in that market, according to DrivenArabia — so whether brand value can support that premium is the core question for globalisation.[s26][s18] This is our analysis, not a forecast of financial results.[s15]
outlook.zh:
公司公开规划。比亚迪表示，仰望将于 2026 年初从中东（阿联酋）开始全球布局，随后进入欧洲与美洲。[s18][s27] 产品节奏上，2026 款 U7/U8/U8L 已于 2026 年 3 月上市，U8L 鼎藏版四座于 2026 年 8 月上市，首款超豪华行政轿车鼎曜（YANGWANG ALTIOR）将于 2026 年 11 月初在迪拜全球首发。[s14][s30][s24][s25] 以上为披露的计划与目标，不是已实现的业绩。

我们的判断。仰望更适合被理解为树立比亚迪高端技术形象的技术旗舰，而非走量业务；其短期看点在于 2026 款能否稳住国内销量，以及 UAE/中东上市、U9 Xtreme 与鼎曜能否在超豪华用户中建立品牌认知。U8 在阿联酋官网标价 659,900 迪拉姆，据 DrivenArabia 报道高于当地路虎揽胜基础版约 51 万迪拉姆的起价，能否以品牌价值支撑这一溢价，是其全球化的核心命题。[s26][s18] 以上为分析，不构成对财务结果的预测。[s15]

risks.en:
• Small and volatile volume. Full-year 2025 sales were 4,785 units, a year-on-year decline as the U8 cooled; the brand has yet to build a second U8-scale hit, though China EV DataTracker figures relayed by CarNewsChina put January-September 2026 at 3,251 units, up 38.9% year on year.[s15][s24]
  • No separate financial disclosure. Yangwang publishes no brand-level revenue or profit, so standalone economics cannot be assessed from public filings.[s21]
  • Segment headwinds. China's million-yuan luxury market is under pressure: first-quarter 2025 sales of new cars priced above RMB 1 million were about 21,000 units, down 53% year on year, per data cited by Caijing.[s17]
  • Overseas execution. The global rollout is at an early stage; the UAE is the first market and Europe and the Americas follow, leaving Yangwang exposed to import duties, local homologation and unfamiliar luxury consumers.[s18]
  • Technology dependence and cadence. The range depends on BYD's platforms, and the pace of second-generation Blade Battery and flash-charging rollout will shape competitiveness.[s14]
  • Pricing and generation-change risk. The 2026 U8's entry price fell from RMB 1.098 million to RMB 1.008 million, which could affect the brand's perceived premium.[s5][s14]
risks.zh:
• 销量规模小且波动。2025 年全年 4,785 辆、同比回落（U8 降温），尚未打造出第二款 U8 级产品；不过据 China EV DataTracker 数据（CarNewsChina 转引），2026 年 1–9 月交付 3,251 辆，同比增长 38.9%。[s15][s24]
  • 无独立财务披露。品牌未披露营收与利润，无法从公开文件评估品牌独立盈利。[s21]
  • 细分市场承压。国内百万级豪车市场面临压力：据《财经》引用的数据，2025 年一季度成交价超 100 万元的新车销量约 2.1 万辆，同比下滑 53%。[s17]
  • 海外执行。全球化刚起步，阿联酋为首站，欧洲、美洲在后，面临进口关税、本地化认证与陌生消费群体等风险。[s18]
  • 技术依赖与节奏。全系依赖比亚迪平台，第二代刀片电池与闪充技术的量产节奏将影响竞争力。[s14]
  • 价格与换代风险。2026 款 U8 起售价由 109.8 万元下调至 100.8 万元，换代与价格调整可能影响品牌溢价感知。[s5][s14]
